The full checkout regression was not rerun for D17 because D17 changed no product code; the last code-bearing result is recorded explicitly rather than relabeled as a new run.
The exact candidate sandbox has no .git metadata by design, so Git-dependent tests and repository status checks are not claimed from it.
No hosted workflow or GitHub Actions evidence was used.
